parsed.summary: This paper introduces DeFiFusion, a dual-modal framework designed to detect Price Manipulation Attacks (PMAs) in Decentralized Finance (DeFi) by jointly modeling transaction events and smart contract semantics. By utilizing a Dual-Modal Projection-Fusion Transformer with T5-style relative positional encoding, the framework captures cyclic execution patterns. Evaluated on a dataset of 225 real-world PMA incidents, DeFiFusion achieves state-of-the-art performance, recalling 222 cases with 96.10% precision.

chk_problem.value: Existing price manipulation attack detection paradigms suffer from a disconnect between transaction-centric methods and static contract analyses, undermining their reliability.
chk_problem.paper_quote: This disconnect undermines the reliability and practicality of PMA detection.

chk_method.value: DeFiFusion, a dual-modal detection framework that combines price-manipulation-aware event encoding, LLM-based contract semantic extraction, and a Dual-Modal Projection-Fusion Transformer (DPF-Transformer) with T5-style relative positional encoding.
chk_method.paper_quote: We present DeFiFusion, a dual-modal PMA detection framework that closes this gap by jointly modeling transaction events and smart contract semantics within a unified pipeline.

chk_data.value: Two datasets: D1, containing 225 real-world PMA incidents from 2020 to 2026 across 6 networks, and D2, containing 1,150 benign transactions across 435 DeFi applications.
chk_data.paper_quote: The first dataset, denoted as D1, encompasses 225 DeFi applications across 6 blockchain networks that fell victim to PMA between 2020 and 2026, involving a cumulative financial loss of $804.3M.

chk_setup.value: The framework was implemented using DeepSeek-Coder-7B-Instruct-v1.5 as the frozen LLM, trained with a batch size of 4, dropout rate of 0.3, and initial learning rate of 10^-5.
chk_setup.paper_quote: We employ DeepSeek-Coder-7B-Instruct-v1.5 [14] as the default LLM (kept frozen).

chk_primary_result.value: DeFiFusion achieved state-of-the-art performance, recalling 222 out of 225 PMA cases with a precision of 96.10%.
chk_primary_result.paper_quote: Extensive experiments demonstrate that DeFiFusion consistently achieves state-of-the-art detection performance, effectively recalling 222 of the 225 PMA cases while maintaining a precision of 96.10%.

chk_secondary_result.value: In a forward-looking evaluation on 2026 DeFi activity, DeFiFusion achieved 100% recall on 18 real-world PMA incidents.
chk_secondary_result.paper_quote: Moreover, in a forward-looking evaluation on 2026 DeFi activity, DeFiFusion attains 100% recall on 18 real-world PMA incidents, demonstrating its practicality for real-world DeFi security monitoring.

chk_baseline.value: DeFiFusion was compared against three state-of-the-art tools: DeFiRanger, DeFort, and DeFiScope.
chk_baseline.paper_quote: To address RQ1, we evaluated DeFiFusion and compared it against three SOTA tools: DeFiRanger [6], DeFort [11], and DeFiScope [9].

chk_conclusion.value: DeFiFusion consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in accuracy, robustness, and practical effectiveness by successfully combining transaction events and smart contract semantics.
chk_conclusion.paper_quote: Extensive evaluation on two datasets, including 225 real-world PMA incidents newly collected in this study and 1,150 benign transactions, demonstrates that DeFiFusion consistently surpasses SOTA methods in accuracy, robustness, and practical effectiveness for detecting complex price manipulations.

chk_limitation.value: The model's capability is limited when dealing with unverified or closed-source contracts that only disclose bytecode, as it degenerates into a unimodal detector.
chk_limitation.paper_quote: For unverified or closed-source contracts that disclose only bytecode, the model degenerates into a unimodal detector, limiting its capacity to capture complex manipulation logic.
